    • fillForAllBloodExtractors

      public static void fillForAllBloodExtractors(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, int minimumMB, int maximumMB)
      Fill all the Blood Extractors on a player's hotbar for a given fluid amount. It will fill Blood Extractors until the predefined blood amount is depleted. (It fills on at a time).
      Parameters:
      player - The player to the the Blood Extractors for.
      minimumMB - The minimum amount to fill. (inclusive)
      maximumMB - The maximum amount to fill. (exclusive)
